### Description

Galactomyces 95 Tone Balancing Essence contains a high concentration of galactomyces ferment filtrate to improve skin tone and texture. It nourishes and hydrates while gradually brightening dullness and refining uneven areas. With regular use, it leaves your skin smoother, clearer, and more radiant.

**Key Features**

• 95% galactomyces ferment filtrate
• Refines texture and balances skin tone
• Promotes hydration and radiance

### How to Use

Use a few drops on clean skin, spread evenly, and pat gently.

### What's in it

Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate, Niacinamide, Panthenol, Glycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Butylene Glycol, Betaine, Sodium Hyaluronate, Allantoin, Xanthan Gum, Ethyl Hexanediol, Adenosine


### Additional Information

100ml

### How do I incorporate this essence into my skincare routine?

Apply this essence after cleansing and toning but before serums and moisturizer. Use 2-3 drops on clean skin, gently patting until fully absorbed for optimal penetration.

### What skin types can benefit from this galactomyces essence?

This essence is suitable for all skin types, especially those with dull, uneven skin tone or rough texture. Its gentle fermented formula makes it ideal for sensitive skin while being effective for oily and combination skin types.

### How long does it take to see visible improvements in skin tone and texture?

Most users notice improved skin hydration within the first week of use. Visible improvements in skin tone, texture, and overall radiance typically become apparent after 2-4 weeks of consistent daily application.

## Description

Refresh your skin with Fresh Power Shower Gel. This hydrating formula gently cleanses while helping maintain your skin's natural moisture balance for a smooth, comfortable feel. Infused with notes of bergamot, pepper, lavender, geranium, and cedarwood, it leaves behind a fresh, masculine fragrance that's perfect for everyday use.

Key Features

Hydrating formula gently cleanses your skin.

Helps maintain your skin's natural moisture balance.

Fresh masculine fragrance with bergamot and cedarwood notes.

## How to Use

Apply on your hands or loofah, bring to a lather and wash all over. Rinse with warm water.

## What's in it

Aqua (Water), Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES), Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Glycerin, Cocamide DEA, Panthenol, Isopropyl Palmitate, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Zinc PCA, Opuntia Coccinellifera (Cactus) Flower Extract, Parfum, Cedrus Libani Bark (Cedarwood) Extract, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate, Polyquaternium-7, Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E), Sodium Benzoate, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, EDTA.

## Description

Boost your skin’s natural radiance with Telofill Booster Serum. Infused with Hyaluronic Acid and Collagen, it deeply hydrates and revitalizes dull, tired skin, enhancing texture and promoting a youthful glow. Lightweight and fast-absorbing, this serum leaves your skin plump, refreshed, and ready to shine.

Key Features

## How to Use

Apply a sufficient amount (1-2 drops) onto clean skin, covering all areas 3 times a week.

Aqua, Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe) Leaf Juice, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Isopropyl Myristate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hyaluronic Acid, Marine Collagen, Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract, Snail Secretion Filtrate, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Panthenol, Polysorbate 20, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract, Mel (Honey), Phenoxyethanol, Allantoin, Butylated Hydroxytoluene, Potassium Sorbate, EDTA, Citric Acid.

## Description

Enjoy a refreshing cleanse with Telofill Very Berry Body Wash. Its vibrant berry fragrance fills your shower, while Sulfora White helps lighten the skin. Enriched with Vitamin C, it refreshes, brightens, and nourishes, leaving your skin feeling soft, revitalized, and delicately scented.

Key Features

Gently cleanses while brightening skin with Sulfora White.

Refreshes and rejuvenates with the added benefit of Vitamin C.

## How to Use

Apply the body wash to your body, massaging in light, gentle motions using your fingers or a loofah.

## Description

Achieve a radiant, glass-skin finish with Telofill Glowing Serum. Powered by Ceramide and Peptide Complex, it evens out skin tone, reduces dark spots, and enhances your natural glow. Lightweight and fast-absorbing, it provides deep hydration, leaving your skin luminous and youthful.

Key Features

Evens out skin tone and reduces dark spots for a radiant, glass-skin finish.

Provides deep hydration, leaving skin luminous, smooth, and youthful.

## How to Use

Apply a sufficient amount (1-2 drops) onto clean skin, covering all areas 3 times a week.

## What's in it

Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglycerides, Ceramide NP (and) Ceramide AP (and) Ceramide EOP (and) Phytosphingosine (and) Cholesterol (and) Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate (and) Carbomer (and) Xanthan Gum (Ceramide Complex), Hydrolyzed Collagen, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Centella Asiatica Extract, Palmitoyl Oligopeptide, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Isopropyl Myristate, Cyclopentasiloxane, Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Juice, Carboxymethyl Cellulose (CMC), Hyaluronic Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Potassium Sorbate, Allantoin, Snail Secretion Filtrate, EDTA.

## Description

This daily cleanser is specially designed for skin that's a bit oily, prone to acne, or a combination of both. It helps control the production of oil, while gently cleansing and purifying the skin by removing excess oil and impurities. The antibacterial action tackles the root cause of inflammation, while its exfoliating properties help get rid of clogged pores and prevent acne breakouts. Plus, it has anti-inflammatory properties to reduce the risk of scarring.

# Birch Moisturizing Toner Pad

Brand: ROUND LAB

Type: Toner

Regular price EGP 1,340.00 Sale price EGP 1,340.00 Regular price EGP 1,980.00 Unit price / per Sold out or 4 interest-free payments of EGP 335.00

## Description

Soothe and replenish your skin with Birch Moisturizing Toner Pad, a low-pH pad designed to cool and comfort tired or irritated skin. Its three-layer sheet holds a generous amount of essence, while Aquaxyl helps lock in moisture and prevent water loss. Enriched with Panthenol, Allantoin, and Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, it leaves your skin feeling refreshed, calm, balanced, and deeply hydrated.

Key Features

Helps lock in moisture.

Cools and comforts tired or irritated skin.

Delivers deep hydration with a three-layer essence-rich pad.

## How to Use

Cleanse the face, then shake the bottle if needed. Apply the toner using a cotton pad or splash directly onto the face.

## What's in it

Aqua, Methylpropanediol, Triethylhexanoin, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), 1,2-Hexanediol, Niacinamide, Pentylene Glycol, Oryza Sativa Extract, Cellulose Gum, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Oryza Sativa Bran Extract, Portulaca Oleracea Extract, Ethylhexylglycol, Cerin, Adenosine, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Polyglyceryl-10 Myristate, Amaranthus Caudatus Seed Extract, Ulmus Davidiana Root Extract, Caprylyl Glycol, Tocopherol.

## Description

Give your skin nourishing hydration with I'm From Rice Cream, formulated with 41% rice bran water sourced from Yeoju, Korea. Enriched with Ceramides, Vitamins B and E, and natural fatty acids, it helps strengthen the skin barrier, balance excess sebum, and improve the appearance of radiance and elasticity. Its silky texture absorbs smoothly, leaving your skin soft, supple, hydrated, and comfortable without a greasy feel.

Key Features

Strengthens the skin barrier.

Helps balance excess sebum and improve elasticity.

Provides nourishing hydration for soft, supple, radiant-looking skin.

## How to Use

Apply to a cotton pad and gently wipe over the face, avoiding the lips and eye area. Use after cleansing your face.

## What's in it

88% White Willow Bark Water, 0.1% Betaine Salicylate.

## Description

Revive your skin with Glow Super Vitamin Serum, a lightweight formula designed to hydrate and nourish while improving overall radiance. It absorbs quickly to support a smoother, more even complexion, while its vitamin-rich blend leaves your skin refreshed, balanced, and visibly healthier with a naturally luminous finish.

Key Features

## How to Use

Apply 2–3 drops to cleansed face, neck, and décolleté, gently massage until absorbed, then follow with your usual moisturizer, use morning and/or evening.

Brand: mixsoon

Regular price EGP 1,300.00 Sale price EGP 1,300.00 Regular price EGP 1,499.00 Unit price / per Sold out or 4 interest-free payments of EGP 325.00

## Description

Soothe and hydrate with Mixsoon Soondy Centella Asiatica Essence. Formulated with Centella extract, it calms irritation, strengthens the skin barrier, and restores balance for healthy skin.

Key Features

• Calms and soothes irritation
• Strengthens skin barrier
• Restores hydration and balance

## How to Use

Apply a few drops onto clean skin after toner. Gently pat until fully absorbed.

## What's in it

Aqua, Butylene Glycol, Centella Asiatica Extract

## Additional Information

100ml

## How often should I use Soondy Centella Asiatica Essence?

For optimal results, use Soondy Centella Asiatica Essence 2-3 times a week. Mix a few drops with your regular moisturizer or apply it directly to the skin after cleansing. Let it absorb fully before applying makeup or sunscreen.

## Can I use this on sensitive skin?

Yes, Soondy Centella Asiatica Essence is suitable for sensitive skin. It's formulated to calm and soothe irritation, making it perfect for those with delicate skin.

## Will this essence help with acne-prone skin?

Yes, Soondy Centella Asiatica Essence can help with acne-prone skin. The centella asiatica extract in this essence has antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce acne and prevent future breakouts. Payment Options Payment methods

## Description

Protect your lips with the Sun Care Lip Balm from Luna, crafted to shield against harmful UVA/UVB rays while keeping them soft and hydrated. Made with 100% natural ingredients, it delivers long-lasting moisture and nourishment. Water-resistant and gentle, this balm defends lips from sun exposure and dryness, leaving them smooth, healthy, and beautifully protected all day.

Key Features

Shields lips from harmful UVA/UVB rays.

Made with 100% natural ingredients.

Water-resistant and deeply hydrating.

## How to Use

Apply the lip balm any time your lips feel dry.

## Additional Information

3.5g

## How often should I apply the Sun Care Lip Balm?

For optimal protection, apply the Sun Care Lip Balm before heading outdoors and reapply every 2 hours or after swimming or sweating. You can also use it as a lip scrub by gently massaging it onto your lips before rinsing with warm water.

## Can I use the Sun Care Lip Balm if I have sensitive skin?

Yes, our Sun Care Lip Balm is gentle and suitable for sensitive skin. If you experience any discomfort or irritation, discontinue use and consult with a dermatologist.

## Will the Sun Care Lip Balm really protect my lips from the sun?

Absolutely! Our Sun Care Lip Balm is formulated with broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection to shield your lips from the harsh effects of the sun. With its water-resistant formula, you can enjoy the sun with peace of mind. Payment Options Payment methods

# Micellar Water

Brand: Telofill

Regular price EGP 250.00 Sale price EGP 250.00 Regular price EGP 0.00 Unit price / per Sold out or 4 interest-free payments of EGP 62.50

## Description

The Telofill Micellar Water is the perfect solution for those looking to remove makeup and impurities without irritating their skin. It's gentle on oily skin and non-comedogenic, meaning it won't clog your pores. This product is suitable for all skin types and provides a clean, fresh feel to the skin. It also helps to hydrate the skin, leaving it feeling soft and refreshed. With Telofill Micellar Water, you can easily remove makeup and impurities while keeping your skin healthy and hydrated.

## How to Use

Apply water to a cotton pad, then gently swipe across your face and neck. Use up to twice daily.

## What's in it

Aqua, poly sorbate, hexapeptide, lysine azelate, mannitol, xylitol, rhamnose, disodium edta, phenoxyethanol, butylene glycol, h-castor oil, dipropylene glycol, cetrimonium bromide.

## Description

Refresh and revitalize your skin with Telofill Mica Cleanser, a 2-in-1 cleanser and mask. This gentle yet effective formula deeply cleanses, removing impurities and unclogging pores while nourishing your skin. Use it as a daily cleanser or as a mask for an extra boost of radiance.

Key Features

Suitable for all skin types.

Cleanses deeply, unclogs pores, and removes impurities for refreshed skin.

## How to Use

Usage as a Facial Cleanser:
Gently massage a small amount onto your skin. Leave it for 1-2 minutes before rinsing off with cold water.
Usage as a Face Mask:
Use 1-2 times per week. Gently massage a small amount onto your skin and leave it for 5-7 minutes before rinsing off with cold water.

## What's in it

Sodium Lauryl Sulfate, Panthenol, Propylene Glycol, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Niacinamide, Mica, Glycerin, Chamomilla Recutita Extract, Sodium Hydroxide, Cocamide DEA, Polyquaternium-7, Sodium Benzoate, Acrylates Copolymer, Tocopheryl Acetate, Sodium Chloride, Citric Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Perfume, Water.

## Description

Hydrate and smooth your skin with the Hydrating Body Cream with Avocado & Vitamin E, a fast-absorbing formula designed to replenish moisture and improve softness. It melts into the skin without residue, helping maintain comfort and balance, leaving your skin soft, nourished, and visibly healthier with a smooth, hydrated finish.

Key Features

Fast-absorbing formula melts without residue.

## How to Use

Squeeze 1-2 pumps of lotion into your palms. Spread over your body from top to toe. Layer as you go, adding more lotion to dry areas like your elbows and knees. Rub in small circular motions with gentle pressure from your palms to awaken your skin.

## What makes a glossy lip balm different from a regular lip balm?

A glossy lip balm not only hydrates and protects your lips like a traditional balm, but also adds a radiant finish that reflects light and enhances the natural shape of your lips. It typically contains emollients and gloss-enhancing ingredients that both smooth the lip surface and give a subtle sheen, making it a versatile product for both lip care and light makeup.

## How should I apply a glossy lip balm for best results?

For best outcomes, apply the balm onto clean, dry lips. Press one layer for a sheer, natural look or apply a second layer for more intense shine. ### Description

A brightening serum that lightens darkened underarms skin, unifies skin tone and reduces the appearance of dark spots. Acts also as a 48hr antiperspirant deodorant that fights body odor, reduces sweat and soothes sensitive underarm skin.

- Soothes your underarm.

Apply a thin layer to clean, dry underarms once or twice daily. Gently massage until fully absorbed. Use consistently for best results.

### How do I apply the Radiant Bright Underarm Silky Touch Spray Serum for best results?

To apply, simply shake the bottle well, spray 2-3 times onto each underarm, and gently massage in until absorbed. For best results, use daily after showering. Be sure to reapply as needed throughout the day.

## Description

Bubblzz Coconut Shower Gel is specially formulated without harsh sulphates that can dry out and strip your skin of its natural moisture. Instead, it is enriched with skin-loving ingredients such as panthenol, glycerin, sweet almond oil, grape seed oil, and vitamin e, working together to revitalize, nourish, and deeply hydrate dry skin, giving it the moisture it needs. In addition to its moisturizing benefits, this shower gel features our signature coconut scent. This delightful fragrance will leave your skin smelling irresistibly good for an extended period.

Key Features

Coconut scented.

Enriched with grape seed oil and vitamin e.

Provides deep hydration.

## How to Use

For daily use in the shower, squeeze a small amount onto a wet cleansing loofah.<br><br>
Work into a lather, massage all over your body and rinse thoroughly.

## What's in it

D-panthenol, coconut oil, glycerin, sweet almond oil, grape seed oil, vitamin e.

## Description

Brighten and refresh your complexion with the Whitening Foam Cleanser, crafted to gently cleanse while lifting away impurities. Its exfoliating action removes dead skin cells and helps fade dark spots for a clearer, naturally radiant look. Formulated to soothe and hydrate, it leaves skin soft, smooth, and comfortable while enhancing luminosity and evening out your skin tone.

Key Features

Gently cleanses while removing impurities and dead skin.

Fades dark spots for a clearer, radiant complexion.

Soothes and hydrates, leaving skin soft and luminous.

## How to Use

Apply a small amount to damp skin and gently massage in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Use morning and night for best results.
